title: Nourishing Uruguayan Chicken Ceviche
description: Buttery, aerated solo-dinner ceviche featuring San Marzano tomato spheres and high-protein chicken.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the 200g chicken breast and sear 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Remove the chicken, let rest 5 minutes, then shred with two forks.
Whisk 1 tsp sodium alginate with 1 cup water until completely dissolved.
Whisk 1 tsp calcium lactate with 1 cup water to make the calcium bath.

Using a syringe or spoon, drop the mixture of 1 tbsp tomato paste, 100g diced San Marzano tomato, 1 tbsp lime juice, and 1 tbsp chopped coriander into the alginate solution, allowing the spheres to set for 2 minutes before removing with a slotted spoon.
In a bowl, combine shredded chicken, 50g clarified butter, 1 tsp milk, 1 tbsp lime juice, pinch of salt, pepper, and 1 tsp chili flakes, tossing to coat.
Gently fold the tomato spheres into the chicken mixture, taking care not to break them.
Drizzle the calcium bath over the dish to set any remaining droplets and create a buttery glaze.
Finish with an aerated butter foam by whisking the clarified butter with the milk into a light foam, then spoon the foam over the ceviche and garnish with extra coriander and chili flakes.
